summary: Undo/redo for task moves and phase transitions passed QA review.

checks.name: Undo stack on drag-drop
checks.details: Each drag-drop move pushes the previous phase to undoStackRef. Stack capped at 20 entries.

checks.name: Toast notification
checks.details: Toast appears with undo button after a move. Auto-dismisses after 5 seconds. Toast shows task title and target phase.

checks.name: Ctrl+Z undo
checks.details: Ctrl+Z triggers handleUndo which pops from undo stack and calls moveTask back to previous phase. Only active when toast is visible.

checks.name: Undo button in toast
checks.details: Clicking 'Undo' in toast calls handleUndo. Both Ctrl+Z and button click use the same handler.

checks.name: Stale closure fix
checks.details: handleUndo uses useCallback with stable deps. Ctrl+Z useEffect uses toastUndoRef pattern to avoid stale toast state. Effect has correct dependency array.
